messages:
jordana: Heads up — users hitting broken import with SDK v2.4.0 when bundling. Short repro below.

jordana: Repro steps: npm init -y; set "type": "module"; npm i @redwood-inference/sdk@2.4.0; index.mjs: `import SDK from '@redwood-inference/sdk'` then `new SDK().generate('test')`. Build with webpack5 target web -> runtime error: "TypeError: SDK is not a constructor".

lee: I reproduced on rollup + @rollup/plugin-commonjs: error changes to "(0 , _sdk_default.default) is not a function". Vite dev sometimes throws "Cannot use import statement outside a module" for the published ESM.

pat: Quick workaround: use `import * as SDK from '@redwood-inference/sdk'` or require fallback `const SDK = require('@redwood-inference/sdk').default || require('@redwood-inference/sdk')`. That fixes webpack/rollup locally.

jordana: Root cause looks like mixed ESM/CJS artifacts and an inconsistent exports/types setup. ESM bundle contained top-level require in one helper which breaks edge runtimes. Types also inconsistent for TS consumers without esModuleInterop.

ci-bot: CI failure: devex/bundler-smoke (linux-webpack) failed 2026-03-19T14:02:11Z with TypeError.

lee: Proposed fixes: produce pure ESM and pure CJS builds, add conditional exports in package.json, and ship a single unified index.d.ts with export default + named exports. Add a CI matrix job with tiny webpack/rollup/vite apps to prevent regressions.

jordana: I'll add a short note in the SDK README and release notes recommending the import-* workaround until the republish. Assigning to lee to open the PR.
